## Verdict

Lumen Path costs least for a team of 30, at $270 per month. All three minimums fall below the team size, so every vendor bills for exactly 30 seats and the ranking follows the per-seat rate directly.

## Vendor pricing

| Vendor | Price per seat | Minimum seats |
|---|---|---|
| Gable | $21 | 1 |
| Lumen Path | $9 | 10 |
| Estuary | $14 | 25 |

## Cost at this size

Seats paid for is the team size (30) or the vendor minimum, whichever is larger. At 30 people, minimums of 1, 10 and 25 are all below the team, so 30 seats are paid in every case.

- **Lumen Path:** 30 × $9 = **$270 per month**
- **Estuary:** 30 × $14 = **$420 per month**
- **Gable:** 30 × $21 = **$630 per month**

Lumen Path is $150 per month cheaper than Estuary and $360 per month cheaper than Gable — $1,800 and $4,320 over twelve months.

## Risks

Minimums do nothing at this headcount, which makes the comparison unusually clean but also unusually fragile in one direction. Shrink the team below 25 and Estuary starts billing a floor of $350; below 10, Lumen Path bills $90. Gable's 1-seat minimum means it never pads, so it becomes relatively less bad at very small sizes, though it stays the dearest per seat at every size on this list.

This is a price comparison and nothing else. The price list carries no detail on features, support tiers, usage limits, security or integrations, so a $9 seat and a $21 seat may not be the same product. Nothing here says Lumen Path is the better buy, only the cheaper one.

All figures assume list pricing billed monthly, as stated. Annual commitments, volume discounts, onboarding fees and migration costs are outside the source and could change the ranking.
